principles: Review timing grows with each success (SM-2 style). Cepeda et al. 2006: spacing beats massing for retention over months.
You write the solution from memory before seeing anything. Roediger & Karpicke 2006: testing beats re-reading.
Today's problem avoids yesterday's category unless it is due. Rohrer & Taylor 2007: mixed practice transfers better.
New problems come from your weakest category, and the grader gives specific feedback. Ericsson 1993.
25-minute blocks match interview pacing and the Pomodoro unit. Over-time is recorded, not hidden.
A category counts as mastered at 3 problems scoring 8+. Bloom 1968 on mastery learning.
